question: During an automated mission, when does the Autel EVO Max 4N start RTH after losing signal?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: Autel EVO Max 4N lost signal RTH trigger timing
intake.reason: Determine when RTH starts after signal loss during an automated mission per Autel EVO Max 4N manuals.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: AC 107-2A requires attempting to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, to start emergency procedures; if VLOS cannot be regained, follow pre-determined procedures for loss of VLOS; there is no specific time interval for VLOS interruption, and the remote PIC may land, hover, or initiate RTH; a control link check is required before flight. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: Finish Action Auto RTH triggers RTH after mission completion; Signal Loss Action Auto RTH triggers after disconnection, with continued reconnect attempts and automatic return if the link is restored within 10 seconds. Incident reports (unverified): ASRS notes loss of control shortly after takeoff and reports that all RTH attempts failed.

claims.text: When there is a loss of control link, AC 107-2A states to "Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft."
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If the connection cannot be reestablished, AC 107-2A instructs to "start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link."
claims.quote: start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: AC 107-2A notes that if the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should "follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS."
claims.quote: follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

claims.text: There is no specific time interval for interruption of VLOS; AC 107-2A also indicates the remote PIC may need to land, hover, or employ a return-to-home sequence when VLOS is interrupted.
claims.quote: no specific time interval exists in which interruption of VLOS is permissible

claims.text: AC 107-2A states that, before flight, the remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations over people, reinforcing preparedness for loss of control link.
claims.quote: The remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations over people.

claims.text: During automated flight missions, if Finish Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will initiate RTH upon completing the mission.
claims.quote: During automated flight missions, if Finish Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will initiate RTH upon completing the mission.
conditions: Finish Action is set to Auto RTH

claims.text: If Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will trigger RTH after the Autel Enterprise App displays the warning message: Aircraft disconnected.
claims.quote: If Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will trigger RTH after the Autel Enterprise App displays the warning message: Aircraft disconnected.
conditions: Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH
Autel Enterprise App displays warning Aircraft disconnected

claims.text: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: The ASRS reporter says 'Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.' and indicates that all attempts of Return To Home features failed.
claims.quote: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.

gaps.text: No specific time interval for VLOS loss in FAA guidance; may land or RTH, while Autel manual states Auto RTH triggers after disconnection.
Link restoration within 10 seconds returns control to remote, but incident report says RTH failed entirely.
Auto RTH on mission finish (Finish Action) vs Auto RTH on signal loss (disconnection trigger).

removed_claims.text: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds (e.g., remote controller power-off), the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
removed_claims.quote: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds (e.g., remote controller power-off), the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.

decisions.reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

C001.rationale: The cited passage states: 'Describe what will be done if the hazard occurs. Example: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.' which matches the claim's wording and condition (loss of control link).

C002.rationale: The cited passage states: 'If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.' which exactly matches the claim's instruction.

C003.rationale: The cited passage states: 'If the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.' which aligns with the claim.

C004.rationale: The cited passage states there is no specific time interval for interruption of VLOS and that the remote PIC may need to land, hover, or return-to-home when VLOS is interrupted.

C005.rationale: The cited passage notes the remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations over people, and mentions preflight procedures related to control link loss.

C006.rationale: The cited passage states that during automated flight missions, finishing action Auto RTH triggers RTH upon completing the mission.

C007.rationale: The cited passage states that if Signal Loss Action is Auto RTH, RTH is triggered after the Autel Enterprise App displays the Aircraft disconnected warning.

C008.rationale: The cited passage states that during automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.

C009.rationale: The cited passage states that if the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

C011.rationale: The cited ASRS passage contains the exact quoted statement about losing control after takeoff and states that all attempts of Return To Home failed.
